itemsession.skeleton: 6 slots, one per axis (life/info/chamber/aggression/tempo/shield); ladder 6/6-5/5-4/4 = HYPOTHESIS until gate 5

slots_decided.1 life: PASSPORT unchanged: +1 cover, locked at max 5. Name stays (user).
slots_decided.2 info: GEIGER (was SPYCAM): privately reports HOW MANY of the next 2 rounds are live (0/1/2), never which. Edge rules: re-scan of unchanged window = same report; 1 round left = reports on 1. Legal: zero positional reveal, strongest divergence.
slots_decided.4 aggression: POISON (user's final spec 2026-07-10): my LIVE hit deals 1 now + 1 more when MY turn comes again. NO CURE — PASSPORT heals HP but never removes the pending tick; PASSPORT stays locked at max cover as normal. No stacking (max 1 pending tick per victim, ruling 3). Blank = wasted (saw precedent). Poisoner dies before their turn -> tick fires immediately (proposed, flag at build). Divergence #2.
slots_decided.3 chamber: MAGNET: eject current round for good — ejected round shown ONLY to the user (private reveal, user 2026-07-10). Lie fuel + GEIGER deduction combo. Reload-on-empty rule unchanged.
slots_decided.5 tempo: SHAKEDOWN (was SEDATIVE) = TURN TAX (user's design): place on target; their next turn they choose — pay 6 pts = normal turn, pay 4 pts = SILENT turn (existing bonus-turn rights: items+flip+shoot, no talk/trade), pay nothing = skip. Victim picks cheapest hit (bounded, not OP — min() analysis). Divergence #3. Price stays 4, sim referees. Gate-6: pay moment, death cleanup, one-per-target, teammate ban keeps.
slots_decided.6 shield: TERMS (was BLACKMAIL, enum IMMUNITY): function UNCHANGED — place on player, they can't target you with their next shot, expires when they fire, visible chip.

itemsession.prices_ratified: 6 = PASSPORT + SHAKEDOWN (user swapped TERMS/SHAKEDOWN 2026-07-10); 5 = GEIGER + POISON (= flip); 4 = MAGNET + TERMS (= flip-back); specials 0. Provisional until sim + win-cond #6.
itemsession.specials_allocation: user 2026-07-10: EVERY player gets ALL 3 specials at game start; never drawn/recharged again; one-shot each; 0 pts; un-finable; tradable; usable on anyone incl teammates
itemsession.specials_anonymity: ALL specials anonymous. Victim learns: WARRANT = searched + item gone; HANDLER = 'being ridden' at decision; DRAGNET = never knows. Table learns NOTHING official in all three. Specials police each other (only a DRAGNET can verify special-count claims).

specials_designed.1 steal: WARRANT: inspect target's FULL hand privately (incl. their specials), take ONE item of your choice — specials stealable (ruling 1, ratified). Respect taker's caps.
specials_designed.2 see-all: DRAGNET: privately see EVERY player's REGULAR items only — specials NOT shown (ratified: kills the DRAGNET->WARRANT seek-and-steal pipeline; WARRANT = narrow+deep, DRAGNET = wide+shallow, each special keeps a monopoly)
specials_designed.3 puppet: HANDLER: REACTIVE during ANY decision phase incl. bonus turns (ruling 5) — button steals the shot call; victim's target UI locks, victim told 'being ridden' (NOT by whom); handler picks target under VICTIM's constraints (team wall, TERMS on victim, self allowed); victim's armed items (POISON) still apply. SECRECY LAW (ruling 6, user): ZERO clock effect — timer runs exactly as victim's normal timer, timeout follows the STANDARD law (fines victim's cheapest, then auto self-shot); any visible anomaly would leak puppeteering to the table. Anonymous, private, framing machine.

seat_card_v2.cover_meter: 5 punch dots RIGHT of frame: r=3, pitch=12, 6px gap from tile edge (px = x+48); solid=cover, punched = lasting ring 1px @0.30 alpha; RED when shown<=2; +1 = stamp t:0->1 170ms Back.easeOut; -1 = alpha->0.25 60ms then ring; FULL5 = pulse A: per-dot alpha *= 1-max(0,1-|t*6-0.5-k|*1.4)*0.75, cycle 1800ms, continuous, bottom->top
seat_card_v2.chips: LEFT of frame, bx = x-52 (5px gap; leftmost ring seat x~60 lands at screen edge 0); BARE glyphs no boxes: sedated = circle r7 stroke2 + diagonal slash; dirt = serif ! style(15); placer monograms stacked under ! at style(9.6) (~80% of plate name), spacing: sedated->! +25, !->tags +17, tag pitch height+3; chips setVisible(false) DURING stampSeat (audit fix); dead = no chips
seat_card_v2.plates: frame-width w2=39, ny = y+61 (gap22), h2=13; team A (RED, plate 0xffffff) = BOX: white fill, black serif style(12) no stroke; team B (BLUE) = RULES: white serif + 2 hairlines at ny+-13; FFA = bare name only; dead = gray #666666 + strike line; name letterSpacing 2
seat_card_v2.frames: all 1px; team A alpha 1.0, team B alpha 0.5 (THEME.TEAMS fa); active seat alpha 1 vs idle 0.55, multiplied by fa
seat_card_v2.removed: heart pips, tally sticks, plate rectangles, chipT text, strike line object
